{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the cleaning
print("First 5 cleaned revenue values:", sales['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check if any QA orders are in the loyal_completed group
qa_in_loyal_completed = qa_orders[(qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (qa_orders['status'] == 'completed')]
print("QA orders in loyal completed group:", len(qa_in_loyal_completed))

# Compute mean revenue for loyal completed orders, excluding QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA): {mean_revenue}")"}
